scenes.title: The clock matters
scenes.narration: Before any paper-trading decision, start with time. A price without a reliable timestamp can make a clean chart look more certain than it is.

scenes.title: Missing evidence
scenes.narration: Missing bars, stale quotes or unclear session boundaries are not small details. They change what the evidence means.

scenes.title: Filters protect the process
scenes.narration: A disciplined workflow checks whether an instrument is tradable, whether the history is usable, and whether the market connection is actually available.

scenes.title: No signal is still a result
scenes.narration: If the required evidence does not line up, the correct output is not a forced order. It is a documented no-trade decision.

scenes.title: Zero can be the right size
scenes.narration: When uncertainty is unresolved, position size can be zero. That is not a prediction. It is a risk-control choice.

scenes.title: Evidence before entry
scenes.narration: Good research is not about staying active. It is about staying honest. Evidence before entry.
